premises: Heat treatment at ~500 °C induces a heterogeneous microstructure (nanotwins, fine recrystallized grains, high dislocation density) in HEA coatings.
Higher temperature treatments (700–900 °C) cause grain coarsening and reduce hardness.
These structure-property relationships apply to FeNiCrCoCu thin-film coatings.
